mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies around the Verona Area High School with a temperature of 65 degrees.

The Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-term strategy, developed with significant community input, focuses on strengthening our neighborhoods, supporting local businesses, and enhancing our natural assets.

We have a busy schedule today with trivia at both Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, look forward to the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia fun at The Mill, The Bogey Factory, and Paddy Mac's.

In a recent report, on October 3, a 19-year-old man was arrested following an investigation into a stolen firearm case, during which officers also discovered the suspect was driving with expired registration.
Culver's of Verona is open today until 10 PM, serving up the delicious OREO Cookie Cheesecake as the flavor of the day.
